name: sbir-phase1-to-phase2-conversion
description: Will a firm's first-ever SBIR/STTR Phase I award convert into a Phase II award from the same agency within four fiscal years?
split_description: Chronological on Phase I award_year, fixed before any measurement: train 2005-2014, eval 2015-2016, holdout 2017-2018. No embargo is applied, because every feature is read from the Phase I record at its own award year and no label value is ever an input; the only timing rule is that each row's four-year window (ending at most 2022 for the 2018 cohort) must be closed inside the frozen file.
